title: Group Consolidation and Cross-Border Reporting
summary: Group consolidation with intercompany eliminations and currency translation, including India and GCC groups.
metaTitle: Group Consolidation and India-GCC Reporting Services
metaDescription: Consolidation for multi-entity groups: intercompany eliminations, currency translation, INR and AED or SAR reporting and Indian GAAP or Ind AS to IFRS bridging.
heroIntro: One set of numbers across entities and countries, with intercompany accounts reconciled and currencies translated every month.
overview: Cross-border groups often keep separate books, separate advisers and separate reporting calendars. We bring them into one monthly cycle with one set of definitions, so owners and lenders see a single picture.
whatWeDo: Consolidate group results with intercompany eliminations.
Translate currencies and revalue balances each month.
Track and reconcile intercompany accounts, loans and recharges.
Bridge Indian GAAP or Ind AS to IFRS for group reporting.
Prepare parent-company reporting for foreign subsidiaries.
Prepare data for FEMA-related filings such as the annual FLA return.
whoFor: Indian businesses with GCC subsidiaries or branches.
Gulf-based owners or investors with an Indian operating company.
Groups that need consolidated MIS in INR and in AED or SAR.

byPlan.growth: Available as an add-on per reporting cycle for Growth clients.
byPlan.cfo: Included as consolidation support, priced per reporting cycle.

note: Consolidation is an add-on module on the CFO tier, priced per reporting cycle.

faqs.q: Can you report in more than one currency?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide consolidated MIS in INR and in AED or SAR, with currency translation and revaluation each month.
We prepare the data for filings such as the annual FLA return. Certifications are provided by your independent CA.
